discussion_matches.title: Record reviewed matrix-function resolutions and partial results by Matthew J. Colbrook
discussion_matches.body:
This submission adds six complete manuscripts by **Matthew J. Colbrook**, Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge ([official affiliation](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/mjc249/home.html)). Independent proof reviews support three full resolutions, two partial advances, and one auxiliary real-coefficient theorem. The catalog distinguishes these scopes explicitly.

| Entry | Result and catalog status | Report |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MF-03 | **Solved:** uniform complex disk bound for all diagonal Padé orders, including denominator nonvanishing and the sharp order-one boundary | [#41](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/41) |
| MF-14 | **Partially resolved:** exact complex degree-42 coverage certificate for seven products; maximality remains open | [#42](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/42) |
| MF-15 | **Partially resolved:** CE_n ≥ 2n−4 for every n≥3 and CE_4=4; the upper bound for n≥5 remains open | [#43](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/43) |
| MF-16 | **Solved negatively:** an explicit order-two symmetric word equation has at least three distinct real SPD solutions, refuting Hermitian universal uniqueness | [#44](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/44) |
| MF-18 | **Partial status unchanged:** verified odd-Jordan-block rank theorem for real coefficients and scalar regularization; the canonical general complex problem remains open | [#45](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/45) |
| SF-01 | **Solved:** positive-diagonal real H-matrix preservation by every Newton iterate initialized at A, with scaled/affine and Halley extensions | [#46](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/issues/46) |

The [submission record](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/README.md) links every complete PDF/standalone TeX manuscript, precise theorem locator, original source, archive hash, certificate and review. Three separate Codex agents read and independently checked all six complete proofs against the exact catalog statements and primary references. All six reviews returned PASS within the stated scopes. Seven supplied certificate programs were inspected and rerun successfully; regenerated outputs agree with the supplied output reports, and the independent rational-interval word-equation report was generated fresh. An additional reviewer-created symbolic Jacobian audit is included.

All manuscripts carry the requested author, Cambridge affiliation and email. The original sources are preserved. MF-14 has two reviewed wording corrections because its referenced discovery program is absent from the archive; its supplied exact integer verifier establishes the certificate, and every mathematical line is unchanged. Other reviewed sources equal the supplied TeX. Existing constructions and prerequisite theorems retain their attribution. Independent agent review is distinct from external human peer review, formal verification and priority certification.

Original canonical IDs, statements, references and audit history are preserved. Solved entries retain historical difficulty ratings; partial entries retain ratings for the surviving target. Indexes and canonical PDF/TeX exports are regenerated. The branch has 202 entries and an open count of 197. [Final checks](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/verification/document-checks.json) record source/body identity, provenance, author metadata, local links, catalog idempotence and all twelve PDF hashes. All 40 pages were visually inspected, final compilation was free of layout/reference warnings, and Git whitespace checks passed.

This is a **new PR based directly on upstream main**, separate from #6, #32 and #40. Please review and merge it into main. MF-14 maximality, MF-15's remaining upper bound and MF-18's general complex equality are deliberately retained as unresolved.

Closes #41, closes #44, closes #46. Partial and auxiliary reports: #42, #43, #45.

discussion_matches.title: [MF-18] Auxiliary real-coefficient Jordan-block result by Matthew J. Colbrook
discussion_matches.body:
### Affected entry

[MF-18](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/matrix-functions-and-stability/MF-18/README.md): mathematical status and supporting evidence.

### Correction or result

Proposed status: **Partially resolved**. Auxiliary real-coefficient Jordan-block result.

For real $A,Q$ with $Q=Q^\top$, scalar regularization $i\eta I$, and a finite invertible stabilizing limit, the manuscript proves that the imaginary-part rank is half the number of odd unit-circle Jordan blocks. It also establishes semisimple regularity and an exact defective example.

This does not settle the canonical general complex $C,D,R,P$ problem. Its simple-eigenvalue real subcase was already known; the defective extension is an auxiliary result outside the canonical simple-eigenvalue hypothesis. The existing partial status and general complex target are retained.

### Evidence

**Matthew J. Colbrook**, Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, United Kingdom ([official affiliation](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/mjc249/home.html)), 11 September 2026.

Primary manuscript: [complete PDF](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/manuscripts/MF-18.pdf), [standalone TeX](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/manuscripts/MF-18.tex). Precise locator: **Theorem 1 and Corollary 3; Section 8 exact defective example**.

The [independent proof review](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/verification/reviews/MF-18-review.md) records **PASS** within this exact scope, checks the entire argument and primary-source alignment, and records the full reviewed-source SHA-256. Three independent Codex agents reviewed the six manuscripts in this batch. All seven supplied certificate programs passed; exact regenerated output reports matched the supplied results, and a new independent rational-interval report was generated. The [submission record](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/README.md) preserves original TeX, supplied certificates, archive hashes, code and fresh results. [Final document checks](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/eb17ccdfcda222bf1801afe06eb53c822cf9bcae/references/colbrook-matrix-functions-2026-09-11/verification/document-checks.json) cover twelve PDFs and all 40 inspected pages. Finite computations supplement the analytic proof reviews; no external human peer review, formal proof-assistant verification or priority certification is asserted.

Original canonical statements, references and prior audit history are retained. This is a new submission batch based directly on upstream main, independent of PR #6, #32 and #40. A separate pull request will link these reports and request review and merge into main.

### Rating implications, if any

Keep this entry in the open count; preserve difficulty and importance for the surviving target. Do not split finite cases or auxiliary extensions into new catalog IDs.

@ajt60gaibb Please review and merge this new submission pull request into main. It contains six manuscripts by Matthew J. Colbrook, three independently verified full resolutions, two partial advances and one auxiliary real-coefficient result, with six separate reports and complete reproducible evidence. The unresolved directions in MF-14, MF-15 and the canonical general-complex MF-18 question remain explicitly open. This PR is separate from #6, #32 and #40, which are unchanged.
